h1: Flooring Marketing for Installers and Showrooms
intro: Flooring marketing is the work of getting your company chosen when a homeowner or facility manager starts looking for new floors, then proving which channel produced each installed job. ASP runs SEO, Google and Local Services Ads, and Facebook ads for flooring installers and showrooms, measured against booked revenue.

sections.heading: How flooring demand works
paragraphs: BLS expects new-home construction and the renovation of existing homes to be the primary source of flooring and tile installation work through 2035. It projects employment of flooring installers and tile and stone setters to grow 4 percent from 2025 to 2035.

Homeowners are hiring out more of their projects. Harvard's Joint Center for Housing Studies (JCHS) reports that from 2021 to 2023, owner spending on skilled-labor projects, including interior replacements such as flooring, grew faster than the improvement market overall. Over the same years, spending on professionally installed projects rose 14 percent in real terms, while do-it-yourself spending fell 13 percent.

Older owners lean toward replacement work. In 2023, owners age 65 and over spent an average of 54 percent of their improvement dollars on replacement projects such as flooring, compared with 47 percent for owners under 65. Write for that buyer too: cost, durability and what install day looks like.

sections.heading: Search and Local Services Ads for flooring companies
paragraphs: Search comes first, because the homeowner typing 'hardwood floor refinishing near me' already wants the work done. We build a page for each flooring service that has real demand, such as installation, repair, sanding and refinishing, in order of what a booked job in that service is worth to you.

Flooring services is an eligible Local Services Ads category in the US, where Google offers it in your area. Google ranks those ads in an auction, and it weighs your bid, how likely your ad is to produce a lead, and profile quality: your rating, review count, response time, photos and the verification checks you have completed.

Most flooring contractors are small shops. Census counted 17,989 flooring contractor establishments with paid employees in 2023, and 13,809 of them had fewer than five employees. BLS says certification is not required for flooring installers, so a voluntary credential is worth showing when your team has one. The National Wood Flooring Association runs a Certified Professional program and says many of its member manufacturers recommend hiring NWFA Certified Professionals.

sections.heading: Facebook ads for flooring companies
paragraphs: Flooring is decided over weeks, not minutes, and that is where Facebook and Instagram ads earn a place in the plan. A homeowner pricing new floors has time to look at finished rooms, before-and-after photos and short videos of your crew before filling out a form.

We build the Meta account in a set order. Retargeting people who visited your flooring pages without calling goes live before money goes to cold audiences, and the offer fits a long decision, such as an in-home measure or a showroom visit. Search still runs first: if people in your area are searching for flooring and finding someone else, that gets fixed before Facebook gets more budget.
bullets: Before-and-after photos of finished rooms from your own jobs
A short walk-through of a completed install
An installer answering one question customers ask every week
Vertical video shot for feeds and Reels, not cropped from landscape footage

sections.heading: How we measure flooring marketing
paragraphs: A flooring lead is not a sale. The path runs from a call or form, to a measure or estimate, to a signed job, to the install, and the report has to follow it all the way. Call tracking numbers and form fields record where each lead came from, and that source is carried into your CRM so you see installed jobs and revenue by channel.

Foundation includes Housecall Pro attribution setup if you run HCP. Where your CRM supports it, booked revenue is sent back to Google Ads as an offline conversion, so bidding follows the leads that turn into jobs instead of every lead that calls.

Crew capacity matters as much as lead volume. JCHS reports that projected job gains will not close the skilled-trade deficit for flooring installers, so we weight the budget toward the services and areas your crews can take on.

sections.heading: What you own
paragraphs: Your website and domain, your Google Business Profile and its reviews, your Google, Meta and Local Services Ads accounts, and your CRM records are all set up in your name. Ad spend goes straight from your accounts to the platforms, and ASP charges no handover or exit fee if you move on. The photos and videos of your finished floors stay in your content library, which matters in a trade that sells on finished work.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for flooring companies?
faqs.answer: They can, because flooring is a decision people make over weeks, which gives photos and video of finished rooms time to work. We start with retargeting people who already visited your site, then test cold audiences once there is lead data to build from. Facebook runs alongside search, not in place of it.

faqs.question: Can a flooring company run Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, where Google offers it in your area. Google's screening for flooring businesses lists general and professional liability insurance, plus state-level business and owner licenses where local law requires them. Google also runs business and owner checks for select users.

faqs.question: Do you work with commercial flooring contractors?
faqs.answer: Yes. The case study on this page is a commercial flooring and concrete coatings company that was invisible on the terms its buyers searched. The work was keyword research, a competitive gap analysis, on-page SEO, local SEO and content aimed at high-value commercial terms.

faqs.question: Do you build backlinks for flooring websites?
faqs.answer: No. ASP doesn't buy links or sell link packages. Links earned through useful content, real partnerships and press are worth having, but we don't sell them as a product.

faqs.question: How much does flooring marketing cost with ASP?
faqs.answer: ASP's Foundation tier is $2,500 a month. Growth, which adds paid media management for Google Ads, Meta and Local Services Ads, is $3,850 a month. Ad spend is separate and paid straight to the platforms, and our pricing page lists what each tier includes.
